scope.geometry: Evaluation of an untrimmed sphere surface under an explicit local decoded-field parameterization
scope.parameterization: center + signedRadius*(cos(v)*(cos(u)*unitU + sin(u)*(unitAxis cross unitU)) + sin(v)*unitAxis)
scope.frame_contract: Finite nonzero pole axis and U direction; U direction is projected into the axis-normal plane only after its normalized axial residual is within caller-supplied finite nonnegative dimensionless tolerance
scope.numeric_policy: Evaluate four products per coordinate using exponent-scaled products and compensated sums; reject non-finite or unrepresentable results atomically
